answer_2.quote: We use the widely adopted Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI) to evaluate topic interpretability. For completeness, we also include the Coherence Value (CV) as a metric.

answer_3.quote: Inspired by the above work, we employ LLMs to select the most relevant topics corresponding to the labels and score them for relevance.
methods: select the unique topic that is most relevant to each given label

answer_4.quote: We recruit eight graduate students majoring in computer science as participants and guide them to accomplish the word intrusion and topic intrusion tasks.
answer_4.guideline: identifying words that do not belong to a coherent potential category represented by the top words in a topic; identifying the topics that are least relevant to the document
